notes.title: Update 0.0.2.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Patchnotes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressed crash reports
[*] A new implementation of the player character for the first-person view has been implemented (in particular, the situation where the hands would randomly shift relative to the camera has been fixed)
[*] The situation where the player holding a first aid kit after activating the PC could not pick up items in the inventory has been fixed
[*] Improved the accuracy of shooting from a flare gun for clients
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.0.1.16
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressed multiple player-reported issues.
[*] Fixed UV flashlight drift when held down.
[*] Adjusted quest steps for the path leading to Guard Tower #2.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by the teleport anomaly located on Guard Tower #2.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 0.0.1.14
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[h2]Voice chat improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added open microphone (can be changed to Push-to-talk in settings)
[*] Fixed voice chat buffering bug - situation when an outdated track was played
[/list]

[h2]Quest improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quest description corrections and additions
[*] Quest chain detailing
[*] Fixes of incorrect quest triggers
[*] Adaptation of the Communication Center quest chain for solo sessions
[*] Added a compass with important quest locations marking on the HUD
[/list]

[h2]Navigation improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some teleportation anomalies
[*] Added additional teleportation anomalies on the Communication Center Antenna
[*] Fixed some collisions
[/list]

[h2]QOL improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved interaction with held objects - it became easier to aim and pick up small objects
[*] Some improvements to location sounds and held objects sounds
[*] Optimization of the mechanism of operation of CCTV cameras on Pump Station
[/list]

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Point Finger gesture to Action Selector (F key, lower half)
[*] Added a blackout zone to Pump Station as part of the CCTV puzzle
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta 0.0.1.10 hotfix
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the coordinate entry system in the RF receiver.
[*] Added sound effects for the captcha puzzle.
[*] Implemented inventory overflow tracking with a notification when attempting to pick up an item with a full inventory.
[*] Introduced new sounds for the deaf monster.
[*] Fixed collision issues on the Rusty Ship terrain.
[*] Added a quest clue on the second tower.
[*] Enhanced visibility of the “Teleportation Bubble” anomaly in the Rusty Ship area by adding a light source.
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta 0.0.1.8 hotfix
notes.notes:
[h2]Fixes & Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the name of the holdable to the widget hints.
[*] Fixed object physics for distraction mechanics.
[*] Added hints for switching flashlight modes (near/far).
[*] Adjusted teleportation after dying in Bаckrooms to respawn players near the mission location.
[*] Updated icons for different ID cards.
[/list]

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Zombies now react to the UV flashlight.
[*] Added new quest-related sound effects.
[*] Introduced distinct sounds for slow and fast zombies.
[*] Implemented zombie death animation when triggered by a mine.
[*] Added sound effect for generator refueling.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made improvements to address crashes.
[*] Strengthened the brightness of the headlamp.
[*] Temporarily removed chromatic aberration.
[*] Added the ability to delete saves.
[/list]

[i]We suggest deleting old saves to prevent potential errors.[/i]

notes.title: 🚨 Patch Notes Update! 🚨
notes.notes:
We've made several improvements based on your feedback:

🔊 Reduced the volume of some ambient sounds.
🎒 Adjusted the placement of starting items for a better experience.
💾 Save devices are now positioned more conveniently.
📜 Modified quest descriptions for clarity.
📡 Added the frequency of the Pump Station for the receiver in the email.
⚡ Updated the appearance of the Power Generator.
🛠️ Fixed the quest state saving system.
🔄 Adjusted conditions and sequences for some quests.

Your feedback is crucial! 💬 Please share your thoughts in our Discord and fill out the Google Form to help us improve the game!

🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/ZErhmwTEcz
📝 Feedback Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdmNSuN2du1quNVLfl_DiOnY3jlnplYaAxhYcQ36RdB39Pfpw/viewform?usp=dialog

notes.title: Closed Beta 0.0.1.6 hotfix
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
- Reduced the volume of some ambient sounds.
- Changed the placement of starting items at the beginning of the game.
- Save devices are now positioned more conveniently.
- Modified the descriptions of certain quests.
- Added the frequency of the Pump Station for the receiver at the email
- Changed the appearance of the Power Generator.
- Fixed the quest state saving system.
